title: Mu-DNA: A Modular Universal DNA Extraction Method
author: Graham S Sellers
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.qn9dvh6

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Incubate the specific Lysis Additive and Binding Solution (Soil, Tissue, or Water) at 55°C until required. If precipitate is present, mix gently until redissolved. Use solutions while warm.

steps.title: Soil Sample Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform lysis for a 0.25 g soil sample.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 g (2 X sample weight) of 1 - 1.4 mm diameter sterile garnet beads to a 2 mL screw cap tube.
Add up to 0.25 g of sample to the tube.
Add 550 μL of Lysis Solution and 200 μL of Soil Lysis Additive, then vortex briefly.
Place in TissueLyser II (or similar) at 30 hz for 10 mins.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature.
Transfer all available supernatant to a 1.5 mL tube without disturbing the pellet.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Soil Inhibitor Removal
steps.instruction: Remove inhibitors from 500 - 650 μL of transferred soil lysate.

substeps.instruction: Add 300 μL (0.6 X volume) of Flocculant Solution, vortex briefly, and incubate at 4°C or on ice for a minimum of 10 mins.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a 2 mL tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Soil Silica Binding
steps.instruction: Bind DNA from 600 - 700 μL of transferred soil supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 1200 μL (2 X volume) of Binding Solution and vortex briefly to mix.
Transfer 650 μL of the mixture to a spin column.
Centrifuge at ≥ 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature and discard the flow-through.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation steps until all the mixture has passed through the spin column.

steps.title: Soil Wash and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA and elute.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μL of Wash Solution to the spin column.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature and discard the flow-through.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 2 min at room temperature, then replace the collection tube with a fresh 1.5 mL tube.
Add 100 μL of Elution Buffer directly to the spin column membrane and incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Tissue Sample Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform lysis for up to 40 mg of tissue.

substeps.instruction: Place up to 40 mg of tissue into a 1.5 mL tube.
Add 260 μL of Lysis Solution, 20 μL Tissue Lysis Additive, and 20 μL PK.
Grind tissue with a tube pestle and vortex briefly.
Incubate at 55°C with occasional vortexing until all tissue is dissolved (>3 hours or overnight).
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Tissue Silica Binding
steps.instruction: Bind DNA from 300 μL of transferred tissue supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 600 μL (2 X volume) Tissue Binding Solution and vortex briefly to mix.
Transfer 650 μL of the mixture to a spin column.
Centrifuge at ≥ 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature and discard the flow-through.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation steps until all the mixture has passed through the spin column.

steps.title: Tissue Wash and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA and elute.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μL of Wash Solution to the spin column.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature and discard the flow-through.
Repeat the wash step (adding 500 μL Wash Solution and centrifuging) a second time.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 2 min at room temperature, then replace the collection tube with a fresh 1.5 mL tube.
Add 200 μL of Elution Buffer directly to the spin column membrane and incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Water Sample Lysis
steps.instruction: Perform lysis for water samples vacuum filtered through 47 mm diameter cellulose nitrate membrane filters.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 g each of 0.15 mm and 1 - 1.4 mm diameter sterile garnet beads to a 7 mL Bijou tube (or similar).
Roll the filter and place it in the tube.
Add 750 μL of Lysis Solution and 250 μL of Water Lysis Additive.
Place in TissueLyser II (or similar) at 30 hz for 5 mins.
Centrifuge at 4,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature.
Transfer all available supernatant from within the garnet beads to a 1.5 mL tube.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh 1.5 mL tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Water Inhibitor Removal
steps.instruction: Remove inhibitors from 500 - 650 μL of transferred water lysate.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 μL (0.3 X volume) of Flocculant Solution, vortex briefly, and incubate at 4°C or on ice for a minimum of 10 mins.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature.
Transfer the supernatant to a 2 mL tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Water Silica Binding
steps.instruction: Bind DNA from 600 - 700 μL of transferred water supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Add 1200 μL (2 X volume) of Binding Solution and vortex briefly to mix.
Transfer 650 μL of the mixture to a spin column.
Centrifuge at ≥ 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature and discard the flow-through.
Repeat the transfer and centrifugation steps until all the mixture has passed through the spin column.

steps.title: Water Wash and Elution
steps.instruction: Wash the bound DNA and elute.

substeps.instruction: Add 500 μL of Wash Solution to the spin column.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature and discard the flow-through.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 2 min at room temperature, then replace the collection tube with a fresh 1.5 mL tube.
Add 100 μL of Elution Buffer directly to the spin column membrane and incubate for 1 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 10,000 xg for 1 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Optional Yield Increase
steps.instruction: For increased DNA yield, repeat the elution steps (adding buffer and centrifuging) a further time.

steps.title: Troubleshooting
steps.instruction: Address common issues during the protocol.

substeps.instruction: If spin column is clogged: Centrifuge at higher xg for 2 mins. Alternatively, heat spin column (with collection tube) and binding mixture tube contents at 55°C for 5 min, then centrifuge at higher xg for 2 mins.
If tissue lysate thickens or becomes white: Heat lysate at 55°C for 5 min, vortex briefly, and proceed.
If tissue lysate and Tissue Binding Solution mixture becomes cloudy: Heat mixture at 55°C for 5 min and proceed.
